confirmation_policy: layout confirmation after complete study at offset 1400000; never tune on it; offset 900000 untouched

predictions.P2_no_cost: No arm lowers mean general_nonblock latest accuracy at 2-4 rewrites by more than 3 points relative to A0, and every model reaches at least 99% answer-free exact-query accuracy on the original development set.
predictions.P3_decision: A2 fixes and A1 does not: the layout itself is the cue. A1 fixes: constant query position is the cue. Only A3 fixes: models need a signal separating second from latest write. None fixes: an architecture or optimiser bias; prioritise mechanism localisation.
